info.title: ZigFS Management API
info.description: ZigFS 独立提供的管理接口。Admin 只是调用方之一；授权用户和自动化系统 可以在不部署 Admin 的情况下直接调用。管理员身份、密码校验、Token 签发与验证、权限和所有业务状态均由 ZigFS 负责；Admin 不参与认证决策。

delete.summary: Delete a folder and its current objects or all versions
delete.description: Requires admin:* management authority. Default deletion uses S3 versioning semantics and preserves historical versions in enabled buckets. all_versions=true permanently deletes every historical version and delete marker under the exact slash-terminated prefix. Legal Hold and retention are enforced. A concurrent write may return 409; partial progress is possible and retries are supported even after the folder record is removed. Physical orphan data is reclaimed by GC.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Slash-terminated folder key; empty and root prefixes are rejected.

409.description: Concurrent changes or remaining live content

503.description: Storage failure; inspect contents before retrying

post.summary: Force cleanup folder
post.description: Requires admin:* management authority. Repairs stale directory index entries against authoritative metadata and runs the shared reachability-based garbage collector. Removes index entries whose persistent record is absent or tombstoned; restores missing or outdated index state for valid directory records. Healthy empty folders, current objects, historical versions, delete markers, and active multipart uploads are preserved. This is not recursive deletion. Unreadable or corrupt authoritative metadata requires recovery and is never discarded on the assumption that it is garbage. Repairs may partially complete before an error; retries are supported. Shared GC can also reclaim unreferenced data elsewhere while preserving all reachable data.

key.description: Slash-terminated folder key; root is forbidden

204.description: Directory reconciliation and orphan-data collection completed

409.description: Concurrent changes or remaining live content

503.description: Repair incomplete or corrupt metadata requires recovery

post.summary: Describe, rotate, schedule deletion, restore, or permanently delete a key
post.description: Requires running KMS and the matching policy action on arn:aws:kms:::key/{id}. Describe uses kms:DescribeKey, rotation uses kms:RotateKey, and deletion lifecycle operations use kms:DeleteKey. Conditions and explicit Deny apply. Immediate deletion supports enabled and pending-deletion keys. Deleting or scheduling deletion of the last key is rejected with HTTP 409 (KmsLastKeyDeletionForbidden). Pending state is enforced by ZigFS; the seven-day date does not trigger automatic deletion.

200.description: Describe returns KMSKey metadata without key material; mutations return {ok: true}.

get.summary: Read the bounded object event feed with a resumable cursor
get.description: Requires management authority. Events come from the post-success object event sink, independent of audit logs and notification subscriptions. Omit cursor to start at the current tail. Cursor expiry, process restart or capture failure returns 409; clients must explicitly accept a gap before restarting. Wait is bounded by bearer expiry. Retention is at most 4096 events or 8 MiB across the process. This is not durable or exactly-once delivery. Order is capture order, not storage commit order.

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: Comma-separated PUT, GET, DELETE, ILM, SCANNER categories

200.description: Ordered events and a cursor that also advances over filtered events

access_key.description: Optional custom AK; generated by ZigFS when omitted.

secret_key.description: Printable ASCII. Temporary token credentials require exactly 40 characters. Generated when omitted.

inherit_policy.description: Use parent user and enabled-group permissions, with the key policy applied as an additional restriction. Disabling inheritance never grants permissions beyond the parent; UI defaults to true.

expires_at.description: Future UTC expiry, no 12-hour limit. Omit for no expiry. Cannot be combined with ttl_seconds.

CreateAccessKeyRequest.description: Owner 可选。省略 Owner 时，ZigFS 使用当前已认证的管理员用户名绑定凭证租户； 省略 policy 时创建 Full Access Credential；省略 ttl_seconds 时创建永久凭证。

policy_document.description: Optional key-specific 2012-10-17 JSON policy. Empty removes this restriction. When inheriting, evaluated as an intersection with the parent permissions; otherwise replaces coarse policy permissions.

access_key.description: Optional custom AK; generated by ZigFS when omitted.

secret_key.description: Printable ASCII. Temporary token credentials require exactly 40 characters. Generated when omitted.

inherit_policy.description: Use parent user and enabled-group permissions, with the key policy applied as an additional restriction. Disabling inheritance never grants permissions beyond the parent; UI defaults to true.

expires_at.description: Future UTC expiry, no 12-hour limit. Omit for no expiry. Cannot be combined with ttl_seconds.

ttl_seconds.description: 提供时创建临时凭证，有效期为 60 秒至 12 小时。

session_token.description: 临时凭证必须返回；永久凭证不返回。

UpdateAccessKeyRequest.description: Sparse PATCH. Omitted fields are preserved. AK/SK cannot be changed. clear_expiry removes expiry for non-token keys; cannot be combined with expires_at.

policy_document.description: Optional key-specific 2012-10-17 JSON policy. Empty removes this restriction. When inheriting, evaluated as an intersection with the parent permissions; otherwise replaces coarse policy permissions.

CredentialPolicyInput.description: 创建请求中的可选策略字段；省略字段时 ZigFS 使用 true。

StorageInfo.description: V1 使用 ZigFS 当前可见 Object Metadata 汇总逻辑对象字节数。 Linux/macOS 通过容量 Backend 的 fstatvfs 读取数据目录所在文件系统的容量。 physical_used 是总块数减空闲块数；available 是调用者可用容量，保留块不算已用。 不支持的平台或读取失败返回 null；used 始终为逻辑对象字节数。

partition.description: 分片扫描时为 0 至 15；完整 GC 时为 null。

last_completed_at.description: Unix seconds of last successful scan since startup; retained after failed attempts.

last_duration_ms.description: Monotonic duration of last completed attempt, including failure.

rules.description: Complete rules in MonitorRuleId enum order; identifiers must be unique and ordered

hotspots.description: Fixed slots; zero address means unused. Cumulative allocation/growth traffic, not live bytes. Addresses need matching binary symbols and load addresses.

since.description: Unix seconds when threshold was breached

alert_events.description: Chronological in-memory transitions into/out of firing; cleared at restart

last_saved_at.description: Most recent successful checkpoint in this process

uploaded_bytes.description: Successful object/part payload; populated per S3 operation

downloaded_bytes.description: Completed GET payload including ranges; populated per S3 operation

failed.description: 5xx or transport failure; internal listings count operation failures

histogram.description: Non-cumulative counts; upper bounds 1,5,10,25,50,100,250,500,1000,2500,5000,10000,30000 ms and overflow

MonitorPoint.description: Memory/capacity in bytes; I/O rates in bytes/s; CPU/errors in percent; percentiles are histogram upper bounds in ms, null for no requests or overflow. CPU and rates use counter deltas; history gauges are end-of-window values.

run_id.description: Sampler startup Unix milliseconds; charts break across runs

build.description: Metadata embedded when the ZigFS binary was built; null for older servers.

git_commit.description: Source commit; empty when Git metadata is unavailable

process.description: Current ZigFS process telemetry; null if unsupported or measurement failed.

cpu_seconds.description: Cumulative CPU time across all process threads

sampled_at_seconds.description: Monotonic sample time for interval calculations; not a wall-clock timestamp

RuntimeDiagnostics.description: Process-lifetime counters and a non-mutating data-filesystem probe, measured by ZigFS.

online.description: Accessible configured data filesystems; not physical disks

ready.description: Index initialized and recovery ready; not a full integrity scan

objects.description: Indexed object entries including delete markers

rejected_connections.description: API connection scheduling failures since startup
